title: Complete scam and money and time waste
body: I tried the app from the web site for 2 days only but saw that it is useless and terrible inclusing only toyish presentations. Then I wanted to cancel my subscription, in My Profile Page, Cancel Subscription button does not work immediately, instead they are sending you emails with new unreasonable offers like 5 $ for lifetime, 1 $ per month. When you insist, they send you an email stating that they are unable to refund. When you insist again, they send you another email stating that they can refund but they need supportive documents like that you used the app for consecutive 14 days. That is the case, I used it for 2 days, and didnt like it. Just disnt like it, I dont have to explain why I didnt like it or prove it. Shortly they dont have money back guarantee, be careful. After subscribing they immediately send you ebook which will cost you 45 $ / month and they dont give any information about this beforhand. Be careful. Do not subscribe.
author: M Kemal Yener
